fixed.explanation: filterCookies prefixed a dot to every cookie domain and used a plain string prefix for paths. This made host-only cookies match subdomains and made /api match /apiv2. It now matches host-only cookies by exact hostname and dotted domains by suffix. It also matches paths exactly or on a slash boundary. pathMatches no longer appends a slash to the request path, so cookie path /foo/ no longer matches request /foo. I assumed the call is pathMatches(requestPath, cookiePath), because that call site wasn't in the code shown.

query.intent: The cookie URL filter (filterCookies) used for listing cookies prepends a dot to every cookie domain and compares paths with plain string prefix. It should implement RFC 6265 domain-match (host-only cookies match only the exact host) and path-match (exact or slash boundary). Also the path check used when sending cookies (domainMatches/pathMatches in network cookie store) appends a slash to the request path, making /foo match /foo/.
query.symptom: Listing cookies for URLs returns host-only cookies for subdomains and for path prefixes like /apiv2, and a cookie with path /foo/ is sent to /foo.

history.analysis: filterCookies in network.ts prepends a dot to every cookie domain and uses a plain startsWith for paths, which matches the reported bugs. pathMatches in cookieStore.ts appends a slash to the request path, so /foo matches /foo/. The fix is to make filterCookies use domainMatches and a proper path-match, and to fix pathMatches.
